title: Embassy in Addis Ababa Concludes 10-Day Uganda Familiarization Trip for Ethiopians
summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Kampala -- The Ugandan Embassy in Addis Ababa has concluded a landmark ten-day Familiarisation (FAM) trip that brought together an Ethiopian delegation comprising media influencers, tour operators, travel professionals, content creators and prospective investors. The trip, from 23rd May to 2nd June, aimed to further strengthen tourism diplomacy, commercial partnerships and people-to-people connectivity between Uganda and Ethiopia.
